nodes.name: Call Gemini Speech-to-Text
nodes.notes: After import, select the existing Gemini HTTP Header Auth credential whose header name is x-goog-api-key.

parameters.content:
## Speech-to-Text Provider V1
Standalone Phase 6B adapter: validated audio to normalized transcript only. Uses Gemini 3.6 Flash generateContent with inline audio and structured JSON. No scam analysis, intelligence lookup, scoring, persistence, or public Respond node. Audio and provider payloads are transient execution data.
